findings: AC-3 Increment Value Correctness - Fully Satisfied: Implementation correctly increases counter value by exactly 1, maintains integer type invariant, and handles overflow protection appropriately. Evidence: Review of js/counter-core.js lines 46-67; unit tests in test/counter-core.test.js lines 36-101; property tests verify increment_increases_by_one property across 1000 random iterations.

AC-5 Decrement Value Correctness - Fully Satisfied: Implementation correctly decreases counter value by exactly 1, maintains integer type invariant, and handles underflow protection appropriately. Evidence: Review of js/counter-core.js lines 76-97; unit tests in test/counter-core.test.js lines 103-176; property tests verify decrement_decreases_by_one property across 1000 random iterations.

Comprehensive Test Coverage of AC Behavior: Tests validate independent AC properties rather than tautologies. Property-based testing validates monotonicity, bounds preservation, and integer type invariants across thousands of random iterations. Evidence: 52 tests passing; test/counter-core.test.js validates exact +1/-1 deltas, edge cases, and error conditions; test/property.test.js validates invariants with 10,000+ total property iterations.

Change Scope Compliance: Implementation stays within declared change scopes: js/counter-core.js, test/counter-core.test.js, test/property.test.js. No unrelated scope expansion. Evidence: Git diff review at commit 3f0cf8b6f607b3fea4bce9a4a7108adce66c45b2 shows exactly 3 files added, matching the declared changeScopes.

Coverage Discrepancy Noted (informational): Implementation result reported 100% coverage, but actual coverage is 86.66% statements/75% branches. Uncovered lines are defensive invariant checks (lines 58, 63, 88, 93) that are unreachable code paths. Core functionality is properly tested and AC requirements are satisfied.

Dead Code in Defensive Invariant Checks (informational): Lines 58, 63, 88, 93 contain unreachable defensive code that validates arithmetic invariants that are mathematically guaranteed by JavaScript + and - operators. These checks serve no functional purpose and represent dead code, but do not affect AC compliance.
review_rationale: Implementation satisfies AC-3 and AC-5 requirements. Core increment/decrement logic is correct, comprehensive tests validate required properties, and change scopes are respected. Minor code quality issues (unreachable defensive code and coverage discrepancy) do not block acceptance as they don't affect functional compliance with the AC specifications.
